text: {"features":[{"name":"Role targeting","description":"How specifically the letter is tailored to this exact Google Information Security Engineering role rather than to a generic software job.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows generic interest in software or security work with little mention of Google, Information Security Engineering, or the posted responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Google or security in broad terms but uses mostly reusable language and touches only one aspect of the role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly applies for this role and references at least one relevant responsibility such as secure development, vulnerability response, or backend tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Connects the applicant's background to several posted responsibilities or to Google's scale and foundational impact in a visibly tailored way."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes a sharply customized case that links the applicant's experience to the team charter, collaboration model, and multiple concrete responsibilities in language that would be hard to reuse elsewhere."}]},{"name":"Security mission insight","description":"How well the letter demonstrates understanding of the security-automation problem this team is solving.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Treats the job mainly as a generic backend or prestige role and shows little understanding of security engineering leverage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses general interest in security impact but stays abstract about why automation, triage, or developer assistance matter."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explains one core security-automation idea such as scaling expert attention, reducing toil, or making secure defaults easier to follow."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Articulates a nuanced view of security engineering as systems work that improves defaults, reduces manual burden, or multiplies expert capacity."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a clear, role-matched philosophy of security automation that coherently links prevention, triage, developer enablement, and organization-wide leverage."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"How strongly the letter frames security work as enabling security engineers and product developers rather than policing them.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not address how the work supports other engineers or collaborates with security specialists."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Briefly mentions collaboration or helping teams but without showing a clear service mindset."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly notes working with security engineers or reducing friction for developer teams."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly frames security work as enabling others through tooling, defaults, or reduced manual burden and backs that frame with an example."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows a strong user-centered mindset toward both security experts and developer teams, with clear empathy for their workflows and needs."}]},{"name":"Academic preparation","description":"How strong the letter's formal education signal is relative to the role's preferred technical background.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides only the minimum educational signal by listing a bachelor's degree as a qualification check."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Provides a bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field and presents it as solid but not advanced preparation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides a master's degree in computer science or a related technical field."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides a doctoral degree in computer science or a related technical field."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Provides a doctoral degree and makes advanced formal preparation feel like a meaningful differentiator through clearly research-level technical framing."}]},{"name":"Professional experience depth","description":"How much relevant hands-on software engineering depth the letter shows through testing, maintenance, launch, and ownership of production services.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Barely exceeds the minimum by citing around two to three years and limited production ownership, with little sense of breadth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a few years of relevant software work with some testing, maintenance, and launch experience but modest overall scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid mid-level depth through several years of relevant experience or multiple production services carried through the lifecycle."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong depth through about five or more years of experience and repeated responsibility across multiple production services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows the strongest sample level of experience, combining extensive years with repeated end-to-end ownership across many production services."}]},{"name":"Go backend fluency","description":"How strongly the letter shows that Go is a real working language for back-end systems in the candidate's recent work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Checks the Go requirement only by naming the language, with no concrete context for how it has been used."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Identifies Go as a principal language but gives only generic evidence of work done in it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows credible day-to-day Go use in production services or infrastructure."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Links Go to specific backend system design or implementation work relevant to the role."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a core strength through multiple concrete backend examples that closely match the role's responsibilities."}]},{"name":"Python fluency","description":"How strongly the letter shows the candidate can build production-grade Python systems, tools, or automation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Python only briefly or indirectly, with no evidence of regular hands-on use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States Python experience for scripts or tooling but gives little detail about depth or production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for automation, analysis, prototypes, or internal services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial Python ownership in services or tooling with signs of production quality."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a deeply trusted language for production automation or services, often with detail about maintainability practices or broad organizational use."}]},{"name":"Agentic architecture experience","description":"How much evidence the letter provides of designing systems where agents act within explicit constraints, which maps directly to the role's agentic tooling work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agents or only gestures vaguely at automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agent-based work but gives little sense of system design, control boundaries, or the applicant's ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agentic tooling or pipelines with identifiable components such as Python agents and Go services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear design ownership of agentic systems, including bounded actions, permissions, contracts, or auditing."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Provides especially strong, role-matched evidence of architecting agentic systems with thoughtful supervision, guardrails, and infrastructure around autonomous behavior."}]},{"name":"AI production experience","description":"How well the letter demonstrates credible use of AI in production rather than mere exposure or enthusiasm.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention AI experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or exposure without a clear production example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States hands-on work with AI or LLM-backed features in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Adds evidence of evaluation, reliability work, guardrails, or failure-mode handling around AI systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial production AI experience with explicit attention to trustworthiness, evaluation, and operational discipline."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability workflow automation","description":"How much evidence the letter provides of building tooling that automates intake, triage, routing, deduplication, or handling of vulnerability reports.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention automation of vulnerability intake, triage, or response workflows."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in automating vulnerability work but offers no concrete prior example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Cites direct experience automating some part of vulnerability handling or report triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a concrete improvement such as classification, routing, deduplication, or materially reduced manual queue work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong ownership of vulnerability automation that clearly transformed the workflow and had believable operational impact."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"How much evidence the letter provides of performing structured security review work such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface analysis, or remediation validation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention structured security assessment work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Refers to security reviews or security thinking only at a high level, without methods or examples."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States direct experience performing security assessments or reviews of services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Specifies concrete assessment activities such as threat modeling, attack-surface analysis, code review, or remediation verification."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys mature hands-on assessment practice with repeated review work and a clear analytical stance on how real implementations fail."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic strength","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates facility with data structures and algorithms through concrete problem-solving examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention data structures or algorithms."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic strength in general terms without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one clear example of improving a system through better data structure or algorithm choice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a technically credible example tied to a meaningful bottleneck, hot path, throughput problem, or scaling issue."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Uses especially strong and precise algorithmic evidence that signals deep comfort applying data structures and algorithms to hard production problems."}]},{"name":"Security grounding","description":"How much external or extra-professional evidence the letter gives of security skill through certifications, hands-on practice, or offensive exercises.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no external signal of security capability beyond general work experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Provides an introductory security signal such as Security+ or casual, occasional practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a moderate hands-on signal through regular CTF participation, sustained security practice, or a stronger credential."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides a strong hands-on signal such as OSCP or clearly serious offensive practice."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Combines the strongest sample signals, such as OSCP plus high-level CTF results or similarly demanding evidence of practical security skill."}]},{"name":"Extra-role engineering initiative","description":"How much the letter shows technical initiative outside standard job duties through open-source maintenance, upstream fixes, or substantive personal projects.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no meaningful technical initiative outside standard job duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small side project or occasional patching, but with limited scope or sustained ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows either regular upstream contributions, an actively maintained external project, or a personal project with real technical substance."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates sustained ownership of an external project or a notably ambitious self-driven system built to production-like standards."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional self-driven engineering through widely used open-source maintenance, especially ambitious side systems, or multiple strong examples of sustained initiative."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How concrete, detailed, and verifiable the claims in the letter are.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mainly on generalized assertions of fit, skill, or motivation with few concrete supporting details."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes some relevant claims but leaves most of them broad, reusable, or weakly evidenced."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports several claims with concrete examples, though responsibilities, technologies, or outcomes remain only partly specified."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Regularly backs claims with specific projects, technical choices, or outcome statements that make the evidence easy to trust."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Builds the case almost entirely through concrete, role-relevant evidence, with specific responsibilities, architectures, or impacts rather than broad self-description."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"How clear, grammatically correct, and professionally finished the letter is as written.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent spelling, grammar, or wording errors that repeatedly distract from the application."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains several noticeable errors or awkward phrasings, though the overall meaning remains clear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has minor errors or occasional awkwardness that do not materially impede readability."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Reads cleanly and professionally with only isolated slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is exceptionally polished, fluent, and easy to read, with essentially no distracting mechanical issues."}]}]}
